meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条设计原则审计界面:逐条打分(0-3 分)并附证据,给出「新建/优化/重设计」结论,最后生成可直接交给 /make-plan 的指令。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当用户说 "audit this design" 等触发词,或要求对设计做评审并期待生成后续计划时触发;常规代码评审、纯文案修改、尚无稿子的构思不触发。

say.text: 按 Dieter Rams 十条原则审计这个界面,逐条打分。
say.note: 生成评分卡、结论和 /make-plan 提示。

say.text: 帮我做设计评审,给出新建、优化还是重设计的结论。
say.note: 结论附带最高杠杆的改进点。

say.text: 对照 Rams 原则检查这个 UI,告诉我哪里不达标。
say.note: 列出各原则证据与 0-3 分。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0-3 with cited evidence, picks a verdict (NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN), and outputs a ready-to-run /make-plan handoff prompt. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", etc., or asks for a design critique that should lead to a plan. Not for routine code reviews, copy edits, or pre-design ideation.

say_en.text: Audit this interface against Dieter Rams' ten principles and score each one.
say_en.note: Produces a scorecard, verdict, and /make-plan prompt.

say_en.text: Run a design review and tell me if it's new, refine, or redesign.
say_en.note: Verdict comes with top leverage moves.

say_en.text: Check this UI against Rams and flag what falls short.
say_en.note: Lists evidence and deductions per principle.
